name: cache-keeper
description: Shows when the prompt cache lapses, keeps it warm with a few pings while idle, then compacts once and waits

ttlSeconds.title: Cache TTL override (seconds)
ttlSeconds.description: 0 (default) detects the TTL Claude Code is using from the session (5 min or 1 hour). Set a number of seconds only to force one.

leadSeconds.title: Ping lead (seconds)
leadSeconds.description: How long before the cache lapses to send the keep-alive ping or the compaction

jitterSeconds.title: Ping jitter (seconds)
jitterSeconds.description: Act up to this much earlier, at random, so pings do not land on an exact beat (capped at 10% of the TTL)

maxPings.title: Keep-alive pings
maxPings.description: Pings per idle stretch before compacting

compactInstructions.title: Compact instructions
compactInstructions.description: What the idle compaction's summary should keep (empty: the engine's own prompt)

display.title: Display
display.description: Where the keeper shows its state: a bar above the prompt, the one-line status, or both
